description: This file defines a FastAPI backend for a Data Product Publishing workflow. It includes route handlers for submitting drafts, running validations, creating approval decisions, and publishing drafts. It also contains exception handlers for request validation and HTTP errors, as well as startup initialization and middleware configuration. The code emphasizes content type enforcement, request validation, auditing, and standardized error responses, adhering to specific test and contract requirements.
